stories.headline: Steam Frame gets SteamOS 0.4: better battery, streaming fixes
stories.subtitle: Valve's stable update adds up to 12% more battery life and fixes the "Error 17" streaming bug, plus wireless and audio reliability fixes.

stories.headline: NYC nightclubs are banning smart glasses — and threatening blacklists
stories.subtitle: Venues like Queens' Basement now eject — and may permanently ban — anyone wearing camera glasses.

stories.headline: Xreal opens Aura pre-orders at $1,279 — $20 under Meta's VR Glasses, shipping weeks earlier
stories.subtitle: Xreal's $1,279 Android XR glasses ship in weeks, undercutting Meta's $1,299 VR Glasses (spring 2027).

stories.headline: Norway's smart-glasses ban proposal now 'high priority'
stories.subtitle: Norway now calls its smart-glasses ban proposal 'high priority.' Meta's response: the LED that can't be disabled.

stories.headline: Apple reportedly delaying its smart glasses amid the Meta privacy backlash
stories.subtitle: Apple is reportedly delaying its rumored 2027 glasses as trust in camera glasses wobbles. Still just a report.
